title: Project environment registry
description: Committed file. Holds no secret values: every secret is a reference resolved at the moment of use.

secret.description: env:NAME (shell env or gitignored .agents/secrets.env) or op://vault/item/field (1Password CLI).

secretLikeKeys.description: Any key that looks like a secret must be a secretRef, never a literal.

branch.description: Git branch this environment deploys from.

policy.description: autonomous: act and report. confirm-writes: one confirmation for the whole write plan. confirm-each-step: every write step confirmed separately.

allowedWithoutAsking.description: Registry commands (all read-only) that skip confirmation under confirm-each-step. logsQuery allows bounded Better Stack reads (betterstack-logs section 4).

rules.description: Free-text rules for this environment, applied on top of the policy when stricter.

testDataAllowed.description: Kill switch. false: never create, modify, or delete records here outside reviewed migrations shipped through the deploy protocol, even when asked in chat.

testDataMarker.description: Prefix put on every record an agent creates, so it can be found and deleted.

deployOrder.description: Service names in deploy order. Default when absent: db before web, which requires backward-compatible migrations.

scope.description: full: anything incl. destructive and load tests. non-destructive: own marked data, cleaned up. smoke-only: read-only flows with listed accounts. none: no tests.

ssh.description: Host alias defined in ~/.ssh/config. Never a raw IP plus key path.

composeProject.description: docker compose -p value; every compose command must carry it.

sharedHost.description: The server runs other projects too. Absent means treat as shared.

version.description: Prints exactly one value and nothing else: the commit SHA the running process was built from, or for a database the latest applied migration version.

deploy.description: Ordered steps. Under confirm-each-step, each item is one confirmed step.

logsCommand.description: Read-only command printing recent live output, bounded (e.g. --lines 200 --nostream, --tail=N); never follows.

logs.description: Where this service's log history lives, read with the betterstack-logs skill. Replaces the old string command, now logsCommand. No tokens here: the ingest token is env:BETTER_STACK_SOURCE_TOKEN and the host BETTER_STACK_INGESTING_HOST, set per environment in that environment's secret store. One source per project per environment (<project>-<env>); a Supabase drain uses <project>-<env>-supabase, and a Vercel platform drain's own source (<project>-<env>-vercel) is recorded in the service notes.

source.description: Better Stack source name. App logs: one per project and environment, <project>-<env>, shared by its services and told apart by the service field. A platform drain gets its own source, <project>-<env>-<platform> (acme-prod-vercel), never the app source. Exceptions: betterstack-logs section 3.

sourceId.description: Numeric source id, when known; speeds up MCP lookups.

shipping.description: sdk: in-app transport. vector: project-scoped Vector. collector: Better Stack Collector, dedicated hosts only. drain: platform drain (Vercel, Supabase).

login.description: Email or username. Not a secret.

mfa.description: How to get the second factor, e.g. a TOTP secretRef or "ask the user".
